description: Predictions for the Patterns RS-54 to RS-62 of the spec proofgate-implicit-role-paths (paths without iam:PassRole), written on 2026-11-22 BEFORE these Patterns were run with ProofGate and before any code of the spec exists. predictedResultMain is for main at 265b6c9; predictedResultAfter is for the implementation of the design.
